title: Practice: one person's Claude Code setup, in the right files (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 the user level holds a style a status line and a keybindings file that fit together
cases.says: The user level holds a style, a status line and a keybindings file that fit together

cases.id: e1 the style file keeps the coding instructions and carries only documented fields
cases.says: The style file keeps the coding instructions and carries only documented fields

cases.id: e2 the status line reads only fields the session sends and refreshes no faster than every second
cases.says: The status line reads only fields the session sends and refreshes no faster than every second

cases.id: e3 the keybindings use real contexts and actions free keys and a null to unbind
cases.says: The keybindings use real contexts and actions, free keys and a null to unbind

cases.id: e4 personal settings stay in the user files and the project file stays shared
cases.says: Personal settings stay in the user files and the project file stays shared

cases.id: e5 the local settings file is kept out of git
cases.says: The local settings file is kept out of git

cases.id: e6 no file holds a personal path an address a key or an unfinished marker
cases.says: No file holds a personal path, an address, a key or an unfinished marker
